frequency_question: What proportion of major federal administrative/mandate bills successfully pass the U.S. Senate within a single 358-day congressional session window from introduction?
membership_rule: Includes bills establishing new federal mandates with multi-agency compliance rules; excludes routine appropriations, continuing resolutions, and purely ceremonial measures.

cases.name: Border Security and Asylum Reform Act (2018)
Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act (2024)

coverage_note: 9 named prominent Senate-considered major policy bills within recent congresses; believed representative of contentious legislative throughput.
known_gaps: Excludes minor non-controversial bills that pass via unanimous consent, as the SAVE Act is highly contested structurally.
validity_reason: Tied to the stability of Senate procedural rules (such as the legislative filibuster threshold) which remain constant through the current congressional session.
